description: This file provides a utility function to asynchronously check if a given file exists by utilizing the Node.js 'fs/promises' API. It exports the function 'fileExists' which takes an optional file path string or null and returns a promise resolving to a boolean indicating the existence of the file.

methods.description: Asynchronously checks if a file exists at the specified path. Returns false if the path is null or undefined; otherwise, it attempts to stat the file and returns true if successful, false if an error occurs.
